blocks.text: TAGBILARAN CITY, Bohol — Former Cebu City Mayor Raymond Alvin Garcia has filed a motion for reconsideration challenging an Ombudsman ruling that found him administratively liable for failing to object to unauthorized cockfighting events at the NUSTAR Resort and Casino Convention Center in 2024. In a statement posted on social media, Garcia said he disagreed with the findings and conclusions of the Office of the Ombudsman, arguing that his Letter of No Objection (LONO) was not a final special permit authorizing the events. “I have always recognized the importance of accountability in public service and the role of the Office of […]...
